pairs.question: Quos igitur haruspices ludos minus diligenter factos pollutosque esse dicunt?
pairs.answer: Eos quorum ipsi di immortales atque illa mater Idaea te,—te, Cn. Lentule, cuius abavi manibus esset accepta,—spectatorem esse voluit.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-posed interrogative opening section [22] asking which games the haruspices declared polluted; Cicero answers it himself in the next sentence. Answer window is the first full sentence of the reply, ending at 'voluit.'; the following sentence ('Quod ni tu Megalesia illo die...') turns to elaboration and is cut. Stripped the section marker '[22]'. No angle brackets in the chosen span.
